answer: Witnessed Position Logging. Each identity must publish a signed observation of a physical landmark—say, a comet’s tracked arc or a lagoon’s tide gauge—tied to a unique sensor reading and timestamp that only one physical device at that location can produce. A quartz clock drift signature is embedded per device, making copies detectable. An attacker must acquire and place distinct hardware at each claimed site, paying hardware, shipping, and maintenance costs per identity, not a one-time fee.
